# Coordinates

> Free GPS coordinate converter and interactive world time globe by whispr.dev.

- [Tool](https://coordinates.black-ibex-2842.chatgpt.site/): Convert WGS 84 latitude/longitude between decimal and DMS. Explore civil clocks and representative IANA time zone locations on a draggable globe.
- [About and data](https://coordinates.black-ibex-2842.chatgpt.site/about.html)
- [Privacy](https://coordinates.black-ibex-2842.chatgpt.site/privacy.html)
- [whispr.dev](https://whispr.dev/)
- [SkeleTrace](https://skeletrace.com/)

Timezone lookup is approximate near boundaries. Globe meridians are solar guides, not political timezone boundaries. Clocks use the device clock and browser timezone rules.
